title: 第1622章 A7通道冤魂
slug: 顶级奸商无敌从贩卖军火开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【别捡了。。跟上。】

【兄弟…这都是钱啊。】

【你装的下吗？】

【额~】

阿四面露尴尬。

确实，林风和剑不凡又不是傻子，有黄色装备他们也会捡。

材料什么的他们也会拿，因为这些材料能叠加。

装备不行，不能叠加的同时，占格子还多。

【别挑了，你真要，就捡紫色的，其他都丢了。】

林风也很无奈。

不过他也理解。

这货是真没见过钱，白色的都捡，还一件一件装备的看属性。

把不好的丢掉。

真要这样搞，他们都不用找A7了。

野怪越来越多，越来越强，爆的东西越来越值钱。

阿四刚才捡的装备，几乎都丢光了。

他脸上一直洋溢着兴奋的笑容：【是是是。。够了，够了。】

【你最好跟上，不然死了别怪我们。】

【知道了。。两位兄弟，你们不要是吧？出去了可不能问我要回去？】

【靠！】

非但是两个国家的人，简直就是两个世界的人。

在林风的威胁下，阿四不舍得，只能用他们说的方法。

丢掉没用的蓝色装备，只捡紫色。

【木乃伊就算了，为什么有僵尸啊？？】

【僵尸？那不是吸血鬼吗？】

【我靠。。渡硬国被多少国家…影响过。。】

冤魂矿洞里怪物的繁杂，超过林风两人的想象，什么怪都有。

不过实力都不行。

碰到最强的也就5重天而已。

也说的通，毕竟冤魂矿洞是现在出现的副本。

大多数玩家还停留在4重天，所以碰到的野怪4重天最多。

【还没到吗？我们是不是走错了？】

【应该没错吧？喂，阿四兄弟，哪个方向？】

他们此刻身处于又一个矿洞中。

何区别。

阿四看了一眼任务指引，缓缓调整方向，坚定的点头：【就是这个方向没错了，我能确定，从这条通道过去，就能到了。】

【A7通道！！】

【我去，你不说我还没注意！】

他们面前竟然就是A7通道。

之前走过的通道实在太多，都没怎么在意。

Page (1/3)

[Stop picking it up..Keep up.】

[Brother...this is all money.】

[Can you pretend?】

【Um~】

Ah Si looked embarrassed.

Indeed, Lin Feng and Jian Bufan are not fools, and they will pick up yellow equipment if it is available.

They can also take materials, because these materials can be stacked.

The equipment is not good, it cannot be stacked and at the same time it takes up too many grids.

[Stop picking. If you really want it, just pick the purple one and throw away the rest.】

Lin Feng was also helpless.

But he also understands.

This guy has never seen money. He picked up all the white ones and looked at the attributes of each piece of equipment.

Throw away the bad ones.

If they really want to do this, they won't have to look for A7.

There are more and more wild monsters, they are getting stronger, and the explosive things are becoming more and more valuable.

Almost all the equipment Ah Si picked up just now was lost.

There was always an excited smile on his face: [Yes, yes, yes..Enough, enough.】

[You'd better keep up, or don't blame us if you die.】

【knew..Brothers, you don’t want it, right?If you go out, can you ask me to go back?】

【Depend on!】

Not only are we people from two countries, we are simply people from two worlds.

Under Lin Feng's threat, Ah Si was reluctant and could only use the method they said.

Throw away useless blue gear and only pick up purple.

[Forget about mummies, why are there zombies??】

【Zombies?Isn't that a vampire?】

【Holy shit..How many countries have... influenced the Du Hard Country?.】

The variety of monsters in the Wounded Soul Mine was beyond Lin Feng's imagination. There were all kinds of monsters.

But the strength is not enough.

The strongest one I encountered was only the 5th level.

It also makes sense, after all, the Wrongful Soul Mine is the dungeon that appears now.

Most players are still in the 4th level, so they encounter the most wild monsters in the 4th level.

【Not here yet?Are we on the wrong track?】

[It should be right, right?Hey, brother Ah Si, which direction?】

They were now in another mine.

What a difference.

Ah Si glanced at the mission guide, slowly adjusted the direction, and nodded firmly: [This is the right direction. I can be sure that we will get there if we go through this passage.】

【A7 channel!!】

[I’ll go, if you don’t tell me, I haven’t noticed yet!】

In front of them was channel A7.

There were so many passages that I walked through before that I didn’t pay much attention to them.
